visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and a red lanyard, stands in front of a black wall with a large white 'AMD together we advance_' logo. She smiles broadly and waves both hands at the camera. The setting is a brightly lit indoor venue. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of a bustling event hall with grey carpeting and people in business casual attire walking around. A logo wall appears, covered in various brand icons under the heading 'TOGETHER WE ADVANCE AI'. (3) Close-up of a high-tech server unit inside a glass display case; the hardware is dark grey with multiple cooling fins and 'AMD Instinct' branding. (4) The camera focuses on an MSI laptop screen showing an 'AI Marketing Advisor' interface with images of handbags and audience demographic data. A finger points at specific UI elements on the screen. (5) Another laptop, an ASUS Vivobook, is shown displaying CyberLink PowerDirector editing software. The screen shows an AI body selection feature applied to a group of dancers. (6) The video returns to the woman from Phase 1 in front of the AMD wall. She claps her hands together and gestures while speaking enthusiastically, concluding the presentation.
